findings.claim: memex.hcl moves memex's default and reflection models off the retired deepseek-v4-flash:0731, but nothing records it. It is outside the plan, it is not deployed, and live memex keeps getting Bifrost 403s on those two stages until someone applies the applications root. No log entry or memex page says so, so the next unrelated apply will re-register memex without warning.

test_openviking_plugin_is_copied_in_pinned checks that the ARG line holds the SHA, and separately that the destination path and examples/hermes-plugin appear somewhere. It still passes if the curl URL fetches a branch such as main instead of the ARG, which is the "plugin is unpinned" case in r1's fails_when.

entries.change: records that the staged, commented-out memex job now names ollama/deepseek-v4.1-flash because Bifrost 2.3.1 refuses the retired tag, and that it takes effect only when memex is uncommented and applied (memex is not running, so nothing live gets a 403).
the test also requires the codeload URL and the tar member path to use OPENVIKING_PLUGIN_SHA; pointing the download at main now fails it.
